title: His partnership with Mario Bauza
summary: They always understood each other, and Machito deferred to Mario's musical decisions.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Okay, did you and Mario always talked these things over or did one of you just go ahead and do it?
No, we talked over a few times, but it was a personal understanding.
Okay, you and Mario has always been like partners, right?
Okay, and you never did anything without letting the other one know.
And even when he decide for something, it was for the best because he is a top qualified musician. So I had nothing to say for his decision, musically, because it was so well, so what should I say?
